title: Quenched Light Brazilian Shrimp Skewers
description: A refreshing and light Brazilian dish featuring succulent shrimp, this recipe is perfect for warm weather and outdoor gatherings, with a focus on water and pasta water emulsion to keep the shrimp moist and flavorful.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lime juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated shrimp onto skewers, leaving a small space between each shrimp.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the shrimp skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until they are pink and cooked through.
While the shrimp are cooking, mix the pasta water with chopped cilantro in a small bowl.
Once the shrimp are done, brush them with the pasta water emulsion.
Serve the shrimp skewers immediately, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
